slides.texte_overlay: making the most beautiful study plan and following it for exactly one day
what made my plans actually last:

my plan takes 5 minutes to write now.
the 1-hour aesthetic version was the procrastination.

25-minute blocks, not whole afternoons.
easy to start, easy to restart.

one empty slot every day for surprises.
so one surprise doesn't break the whole week.

sunday: i quiz myself on everything from the week.
the plan for next week starts from what i missed.

it's taped above my desk.
not hidden in an app i never open.

and i tick every finished block in red.
seeing them pile up keeps me going.
